question: Does the selective rank-8 target-versus-control response circuit survive swapping every fit and evaluation half?
method: Keep the same eight sites, generic-control rank 8, and target-residual rank 8. Fit generic PCA on C validation and target PCA on odd target rows; evaluate only on C discovery and even target rows. No rank or threshold selection.

predictions.pred_a_authority_disjointness_alignment_: Authorities, opposite disjoint halves, endpoint alignment, spectra, finiteness, and <=10 forwards close.
predictions.pred_b_swapped_target_fidelity: Worst target residual <=0.05 and behavior signed projection >=0.80 in both tasks.
predictions.pred_c_swapped_control_selectivity: Matched C effect <=0.10 target scale in both tasks.
predictions.pred_d_crossfit_target_stability: Each swapped behavior projection differs from v1 by <=0.15 and worst residual differs by <=0.03.
predictions.pred_e_crossfit_control_stability: Each swapped C fraction is <=0.03 and differs from v1 by <=0.02.

decision: A pass identifies a stable within-module response circuit and licenses weight projection plus fresh/OOD testing. Failure closes this linear split as sample-specific.
